description: This file contains SCSS mixins related to creating various types of gradients, including linear, radial, directional, multi-color, and striped gradients, used for styling backgrounds in a stylesheet.

methods.name: gradient-bg
methods.description: Creates a background with a potential gradient if enabled, otherwise sets a solid background color.

methods.name: gradient-x
methods.description: Defines a horizontal linear gradient between two colors with optional start and end positions.

methods.name: gradient-y
methods.description: Defines a vertical linear gradient between two colors with optional start and end positions.

methods.name: gradient-directional
methods.description: Creates a linear gradient at a specified angle between two colors.

methods.name: gradient-x-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a horizontal gradient transitioning through three colors at specified stops.

methods.name: gradient-y-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a vertical gradient transitioning through three colors at specified stops.

methods.name: gradient-radial
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient from an inner to an outer color.

methods.name: gradient-striped
methods.description: Creates a striped pattern with a specified angle and transparency.
